claims.statement: The author's full-column-rank constant-4 retained-U theorem, and its square-invertible constant-2 specialization, are correct for arbitrary D(y), every finite adaptive/pruned shield-variable restriction tree, and one common disjoint retained Boolean factor h.
For every full-column-rank M, U(P)<=m<=2I_x(P), so every permitted complete-tree retained-U loss is at most 2I_x(P); the constant is sharp.
Rank-deficient positive-dimensional fibers and hierarchies without one fixed full-rank shield still lack a dimension-independent nonreused coherent-core payment.
